nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy Pattern
nodes.rationale: All data is isolated per tenant via tenant_id FK with cascade delete; polymorphic and file tables carry tenant_id for scoping only.

nodes.label: Localized String JSONB
nodes.rationale: Stored as { ar, en? } JSONB to support multilingual display without a separate translations table; ar is the primary locale.

nodes.label: Polymorphic Entity Pattern
nodes.rationale: entity_type + entity_id identify the owning record; no FK, so application logic must validate tenant ownership.

nodes.label: Locked Exchange Rate
nodes.rationale: Rate of document currency to tenant base currency locked at posting time (Decimal 18,6).

nodes.label: Denormalized Balance Cache
nodes.rationale: current_balance / stock_balances are projections; source of truth is JournalLine / StockMovement rows.

nodes.label: Reversing Journal Entry
nodes.rationale: Cancellation posts a reversing entry rather than deleting, preserving ledger integrity.

nodes.label: Party GL Account Override
nodes.rationale: Party receivable/payable accounts override FinancialSetting defaults per party.
